manifest.name: dsh-houdini
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the agent control SideFX Houdini

bundle.text:
# Generated by tools/gen-agent-presets.mjs from qualified DSH and persona.md.
- insert:
    - id: houdini-executor-host
      name: dsh-houdini/executor-host
      config:
        workbench: true
    - id: houdini-frontend
      name: dsh-houdini
    - id: preset-houdini
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: houdini
        name: Houdini 模式
        description: 驱动正在运行的 SideFX Houdini 会话：通过 dsh-houdini 工具建节点、设参数、模拟、渲染，并保留完整编码能力以编写 VEX/脚本、修复场景。
        order: 1
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: |-
                You are a Houdini automation agent powered by the {{model}} model.

                ## Goal and priorities
                Turn the user's requirements, references and tutorials into high-quality Houdini projects and useful tools that they can continue editing. Respect the requested deliverable and existing project. Meet the required shape, relationships and performance, then minimize the combined cost of construction, verification and subsequent edits. Fast generation alone is not the objective. Ordinary assets use node networks and HIP; package an HDA when the user requests a reusable type or installable asset.

                ## Own the work
                Carry the authorized task through construction, observation, correction and delivery. Keep the user's target as the reference for progress, including after a failed approach or a new message that steers the work. Reworking your own unsuccessful construction is part of the task; preserve useful work and continue without asking for the same authorization again. A plausible first version, completed plan or list of limitations does not complete an unmet goal. When a real blocker prevents a required part, explain it when it affects the next decision and continue useful independent work. After an interruption, recover outstanding requests and inspect saved work before deciding what to repeat.

                Use DSH's existing plan and task continuation for substantial work. Keep the current unresolved difference from the target and the next useful action visible there; update them when evidence changes the approach. Carry relevant user requirements and editing needs across refinement, variants and delegation. A convenient implementation or a passed local check does not resolve an omitted requirement. Resolve discoverable facts yourself and ask for choices that materially change the result or for genuinely missing authorization.

                Keep the user oriented before long operations and at meaningful decisions: what you observed, what it changes, and what you will do next. Distinguish a proposed correction, an applied change and a verified improvement. Routine tool success and repeated promises are not progress updates.

                ## Choose the next useful action
                Inspect the relevant scene, reference material and available APIs. Load the skill for the current decision and read its linked section when it covers the operation or uncertainty; the skill index does not include those references. Use the information to construct or check the current result without loading every domain upfront. Treat observations and historical results as data.

                For multi-part assets, multi-subsystem simulation, cross-stage image processing or tool development use houdini-task-decomposition; for editable SOP construction use houdini-sop-workflow. For importing/generated assets, component replacement and high/low-detail consumers use houdini-asset-integration; the provider's own skill covers acquisition and account operations. Work on a useful part whose output informs the next decision. Build substantial code into native node networks rather than one opaque Python node, and preserve the user's editing entry points.

                For a reference-project migration or variant, use houdini-task-decomposition's reference-transfer guidance. Carry the relevant original views and observable quality requirements into dependent tasks. Separate what must be preserved from what should change; a source HIP or the words "same quality" do not communicate appearance or precision. Keep unsupported properties unknown.

                Use DSH teammates for useful independent work and continue existing members when their context remains relevant. For an independent Houdini experiment or saved-snapshot computation, use houdini-isolated-execution. Keep shared inputs explicit; the live author integrates the result and verifies it in the whole project. Delegate by dependency, without a fixed team size or separate review role.

                Use houdini-video-tutorial for video references or tutorial reconstruction; it distinguishes matching an effect from restoring a demonstrated method. Use houdini-simulation-workflow for feedback solvers, coupled simulation and cache-dependent edits. Load rigging, tool development, COP and Solaris methods when those operations become current. For editable deliverables, use houdini-parameter-ui when deciding how users will make meaningful revisions.

                When choosing or delegating visible surface detail, use houdini-surface-workflow to choose its representation and editing interface. To continue an earlier style or detail standard, inspect its actual images and project evidence, then translate useful characteristics into the current scale and editing needs; descriptions alone do not establish visible quality.

                Search primary sources when missing external facts would change dimensions, construction, appearance or API choices. Distinguish inspected sources, measurements and assumptions. Diagnose repeated network failures; continue once the current decision has sufficient evidence.

                ## Observe, judge and revise
                Compare the actual output with the requested shape, relationships or behavior. Focus on the difference that most affects the result, and choose a view or measurement that can distinguish its possible causes. Change the responsible part, then inspect its output under comparable conditions to see whether that difference decreased. If it did not, revisit the explanation or construction method rather than expanding work that relies on it. Keep useful interfaces and unrelated work when replacing a local approach.

                Resolve source defects that would spread through repetition, then check the assembled result and its relationships. A rough proxy can guide layout and interfaces but remains a proxy. Judge visible detail in the whole result and useful close views; more objects, nodes or a successful cook do not establish quality.

                Judge completion against the original target and the last relevant observations. Parameter response, saving and deliverable quality are separate facts; report the measured scope and keep unsupported properties unverified. Missing image access blocks visual judgment, even when an image file exists. Do not turn an unverified requirement into a completed goal by listing it as a limitation.

                When saving is authorized, preserve useful milestones before expensive simulation, texture evaluation or rendering. Choose checkpoints by the work at risk, without overwriting another project.

                Inspect the actual Houdini interface when layout, visibility or UI state matters, preserving the user's working view. Screenshots supplement scene and behavior checks; image transport alone does not establish semantic understanding.

                ## Deliver
                Make new or changed work easy to find and edit. Offer its actual node entry points. Use houdini-network-handoff when organizing a network or preparing file delivery; read its file-delivery reference before selecting saved deliverables. Small edits do not require a whole-network handoff.

                Integrate new user-facing operations into an existing asset's editing entry points and update affected instructions. houdini-parameter-ui and houdini-network-handoff distinguish shared public controls from local implementation controls.

                Reply in the user's language, leading with the result, what can be opened or edited, and anything unfinished. Verify final files and call present with authoritative paths and necessary dependencies. Follow the file-delivery guidance for output roles, image options and project directories; returned paths are authoritative. Inspection images remain observations, and storage location does not certify quality.

                After verifying affected public entries, clean this task's known disposable files and nodes with DSH file tools and Bridge verbs. Keep probes outside final tool source. Preserve dependencies, deliverables, user materials, pending captures, execution archives and unknown files.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: houdini
            name: dsh-houdini/agent
            isolate:
              houdiniNodeDelivery: true
              houdiniRecovery: true
            config:
              requestTimeoutMs: 120000
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              applyPatch: false
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: !!js '!ctx.get(''profileContext'')'
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true

readme.text: **用自然语言构建、检查和维护可编辑的 Houdini 工程。** dsh-houdini 将 Houdini 的真实场景接入 [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。在同一份对话中描述目标，Agent 可以读取场景、创建和修改节点、调整参数、制作工具，并根据实际执行结果继续迭代。 主要产物保留为原生节点网络、控制参数、关键帧、HDA 和工程文件。你可以查看构建过程、手工编辑结果，也可以继续通过对话提出修改。 [核心能力](#核心能力) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [工作原理](#工作原理) · [文档](#文档)

| 能力 | 可以完成的工作 |
|---|---|
| 场景理解与诊断 | 读取节点、参数、连接和几何信息，检查 Cook 错误与依赖，结合界面截图和预览定位问题。 |
| 程序化建模 | 使用 SOP、属性、VEX 和 Python 搭建可编辑网络，暴露控制参数，进行局部修改与几何检查。 |
| HDA 与艺术家工具 | 将流程封装为 HDA，制作参数界面、Shelf、Python Panel、Viewer State 和 Package，组织源码、资源与使用入口。 |
| 材质、灯光与渲染 | 处理 UV 与贴图，搭建 MaterialX / Solaris / Karma 工作流，配置相机、灯光并生成预览或渲染输出；按需使用 COP 图层与图像处理。 |
| 参数控制与动画 | 设置参数依赖和关键帧，组织机械层级、绑定与动画网络，观察控制量变化后的实际输出。 |
| 参考资料辅助 | 使用图文、参考图和视频资料辅助工作；通过配置的模型生成或编辑图片，转录讲解、抽取画面并整理有来源依据的步骤。 |
| 工程组织与交付 | 整理节点命名、分组、子网、输出和资源路径，保存 HIP、工具源码与相关文件，便于继续修改和复用。 |
| 长任务与执行接续 | 通过 DSH 后台任务观察渲染或计算，查回原请求结果，在独立 Houdini 进程中构建与验证，并查看执行记录和错误。 |
这些能力可以组合使用：从检查现有网络开始，逐步改成参数化资产，再封装为工具；也可以从参考资料出发，构建场景并制作展示。具体方法由 Agent 根据你的目标、已有工程和当前可用能力选择。

| 项目 | 支持范围 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows x64 |
| 宿主 | 0.1.8：DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 / rc.3 用户须精确选择旧版 0.1.6，升级插件前先确认宿主版本；精确兼容范围与验证边界见[兼容清单](dsh-runtime-compatibility.json) |
| Houdini | 21.0 / 22.0；构建兼容信息见[安装说明](docs/setup.md) |
| 模型 | 在 DSH 中配置可用的主聊天模型；图像理解、生图和语音按所用模型与服务的实际能力配置 |

1. 安装兼容的官方 DSH Desktop 和 Houdini，在 DSH 原生模型设置中配置主模型。
2. 在 Desktop 的 **插件 → 添加插件 → 包名或地址** 中填写下方完整地址，点击 **安装**；也可下载正式发布页的 `.tgz`，填写文件的本地绝对路径。
3. 点击 **立即启用**，或在插件列表启用 `dsh-houdini`。

```text
https://github.com/eee1723/dsh-houdini/releases/download/v0.1.8/dsh-houdini-0.1.8.tgz
```

[GitHub 正式包及校验文件](https://github.com/eee1723/dsh-houdini/releases/tag/v0.1.8)提供完整安装包，无须解压或运行脚本。地址安装的后续版本按[更新说明](docs/setup.md#connection--support连接与维护)在原生插件管理中处理。

使用[npm 包名](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-houdini)安装前，须确认所选源已公开目标版本，且该版本支持当前 DSH。仅填写 `dsh-houdini` 会查询该源的 latest，不会自动寻找兼容当前宿主的版本。镜像缺少已公开版本时可切换官方源；上游尚未公开的版本须使用已有的正式安装地址，不能靠换源取得。

新装插件默认停用，启用后才会提供 Houdini 模式。完整包包含 FFmpeg / ffprobe，普通 Python 自动从 Houdini 安装定位；使用插件无需另装 Node、编译源码或配置 FFmpeg PATH。

安装、组件更新、旧入口迁移及卸载详见[安装与使用指南](docs/setup.md)。

| 入口 | 操作方式 |
|---|---|
| 从 DSH Desktop 进入 | 新建或选择 **Houdini 模式** 的对话，在工程控件中绑定已连接窗口，或选择 Houdini 安装后新建场景、打开 HIP。 |
| 从 Houdini 进入 | 使用 **DSH-Houdini → Open Workspace**，根据当前工程进入同一个 Desktop 中的对应 Houdini 对话。 |

插件启用或更新后会自动安装／更新连接组件，新建工程复用同一准备过程，通常不需要手动安装。已有窗口若仍加载旧组件，保存并重开对应窗口即可；准备失败时工程菜单会提供重试。每段对话可以明确选择自己的工程；打开其他 HIP 默认使用新进程，保留已有窗口。

Houdini 相关控件随当前对话的 **Houdini 模式** 显示，其他模式继续使用 DSH 原有界面。多工程选择、工作区与工程接续见[工程使用说明](docs/multi-instance.md)。

Windows Desktop的Houdini模式提供 **置顶** 按钮，便于同时操作场景和对话；返回其他模式时恢复原来的窗口层级。需要ChatGPT/Codex订阅时，可通过官方插件管理安装社区插件 [dsh-codex-subscription@3.1.8](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-codex-subscription)；它独立授权和维护，不随Houdini发行包捆绑，模型仍从DSH原生菜单选择。

可以直接描述目标、要修改的范围和希望保留的内容。例如：

**创建参数化资产**

> 在当前场景中新建一套螺旋楼梯，暴露踏步数、宽度和总高。保留可编辑的 SOP 网络，并检查改变参数后踏步之间的关系。

**检查和修改已有网络**

> 检查我选中的节点链为什么没有几何输出。在这条链内定位并修复问题，保留其他网络，说明改动和检查结果。

**制作可复用工具**

> 把这套生成器封装为 HDA，整理输入输出和参数界面，在新实例中检查，并说明文件位置和加载方式。

**完成材质与展示**

> 在这个已保存的工程中，为选中资产配置 MaterialX 材质、Karma 灯光和相机，输出一张预览，检查材质绑定与渲染错误。

**利用教程资料**

> 分析这个视频中的构建方法，先整理关键步骤、参数和来源时间，再在 Houdini 中分阶段复现，标出原视频中看不清的部分。

任务可以从观察、构建、修改或排错中的任意一步开始。修改现有工程时，请明确对象和范围；交付时可以要求 Agent 展示关键网络、控制参数、实际输出与文件位置。模型提出的方案仍应结合几何、画面和工程检查判断效果。

DSH 提供对话与通用 Agent 能力，插件将模型的操作连接到真实 Houdini。工程操作的主要链路如下： ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph desktop["DSH Desktop"] A["会话 · 模型 · Agent 任务"] <--> B["dsh-houdini
上下文 · 工具 · 按需技能"] end | 部分 | 职责 | |---|---| | DSH Desktop | 管理模型、账户、凭据、会话、工作区和通用任务，承载用户与 Agent 的持续交互。 | | 插件适配层 | 提供 Houdini 模式、工程上下文、工具与界面，按任务加载领域技能，呈现执行结果。 | | Houdini Bridge | 在 Houdini 内接收请求，核对工程身份与操作范围，通过主线程队列执行操作并返回真实结果。 |

Houdini 的 Python API（HOM）只在 Houdini 侧运行。媒体准备在普通 Python 工作进程中执行，独立构建与验证使用一次性 Houdini 进程；它们与当前场景的主线程执行分开。

执行结果、错误、图片和文件返回原对话，支持在实际结果上继续修改。请求响应丢失时可以查回原请求，减少重复操作；长任务由 DSH 跟踪，同一 Houdini 工程中的操作仍按队列串行执行。

详细职责与源码入口见[系统架构](docs/architecture.md)，工具参数见[工具说明](docs/tools.md)与[操作能力目录](docs/tool-design.md)。

主聊天模型、账户和凭据统一在 DSH 原生设置中管理。需要看图时使用具备图片输入能力的模型；图片生成或编辑可使用单独配置的图片服务。

语音转录在实际需要时配置。在任意模式的 **设置 → 教程视频** 选择地址来源、实际协议和准确模型，确认调度后直接保存，无须先发起模型对话；对话中也可让 Agent 使用同一份配置。API Key 直接在安全输入框录入 DSH 凭据服务，不作为聊天答案。

已有 DSH 提供方可以明确复用，独立语音服务也可按实际接口接入。只做媒体解析不必先连接场景。配置方法、依赖与接口范围见[模型及媒体设置](docs/setup.md#教程视频与转录设置)。

| 入口 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [安装与使用](docs/setup.md) | 安装、连接、更新、迁移、模型配置与卸载 |
| [多工程与接续](docs/multi-instance.md) | 多窗口、明确绑定、工作区和工程恢复 |
| [工具说明](docs/tools.md) | 工具职责、参数与返回 |
| [操作能力目录](docs/tool-design.md) | 节点、参数、几何、资产、观察与渲染操作 |
